summary: Iter 23 — Re-test of all 4 spec changes from iter 22 after fixes. ALL PASS in live UI. Walked the full 5-step setup wizard live (Tester / TS-0001 / 135790 / 'alpha bravo charlie delta'), then drove /templates → pick-default modal flow + /templates → pick-scan → file upload → 4-button toolbar → text analyze → grid analyze → reset → set. Every required testid is present and behaving per spec. The default-preview-modal (highest-priority change in iter 22) opens correctly, cancel keeps the picker visible, confirm navigates to /dashboard. The new compact 4-button toolbar (upload-reset / upload-analyze / upload-analyze-grid / upload-set) renders in a single flex row at h=32, the upload-set button stays in the toolbar row even after the analysis chip strip mounts below (verified y-coordinates pre/post analyze: all four buttons share y=867.8). The chip-strip is a <div> (not a <dl>) and contains analysis-font/size/weight/spacing/count after text analyze. Reset clears both analyses (chip strip disappears). Set button toasts 'Boundary saved'. Mapping mode cards (Quick + Pro Studio) still render below.
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateSetup.jsx is now 731 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting UploadView, the four dialog subcomponents (DefaultPreviewDialog, ResumeDialog, StudioLockDialog, UpgradePrompt), the Chip helper, and the boundary-helpers (BoundaryPolygon/BoundaryHandlesSvg/clamp01/dist/hitHandle/applyHandle) into separate modules. Boundary helpers in particular are pure utilities that belong in pro-mapping-v2.js.

Grid-analyze negative-path UX is correct: when analyzeGridDefaults returns cols=0/rows=0 the parent skips rendering grid-cols/grid-rows/grid-cell chips AND fires toast.info (blue, not green) — visually consistent with the no-detection outcome. Verified in source at TemplateSetup.jsx ~line 122-126.

TripSheetPreview.jsx column headers ['#','Code','Location','City','ST','Trailer','Dep','Notes'] are correct in source but render as ALL-CAPS in the live DOM due to a Tailwind `uppercase` class. innerText therefore returns 'CODE/LOCATION/...'. Not a bug — just worth noting for future automated tests (use case-insensitive matching).

FREE/QCK/STU tier gating: in this test run the freshly-set-up identity reached the upload screen without an upgrade prompt — implies pick-scan is reachable on default tier (or the feature-tier logic treats a fresh setup as ≥QCK). Worth documenting which tier the local-auth scaffold defaults to so test scripts know whether they need to bump tier.

rca of the issue: All 3 critical issues from iter 22 are fixed in this build: (1) handlePickDefault now correctly sets showDefaultPreview(true) (TemplateSetup.jsx line 73), (2) handleConfirmDefault is defined (lines 74-79) and runs setActiveTemplateId → toast → navigate, (3) the inline UploadView (lines 371-558) was rewritten to use the new compact 4-button h-8 toolbar with ml-auto on upload-set, plus the new Chip-based combined chip strip replaces the old <dl> Stat report. analyzeGridDefaults from pro-mapping-v2 is called on the grid path and its result (cols/rows/avgCellW/avgCellH) drives the grid chips. No new defects observed.
